what: A scratch file committed into a release surfaced only a branch later. A short-lived scratch document, never meant to be tracked, rode into a commit and was noticed only once a later, stacked branch showed it as modified.
rule: A change that adds a scratch-shaped file never enters a commit unmerged.
fix: Enforcement: pushing a reviewed change now refuses when its diff adds a file matching a small set of known scratch patterns, naming the offending path, unless an explicit, reasoned exemption names that exact file. Regression coverage is in `tests/ship-125.test.mjs`.
